ai_answer_provenance_note: The service distinguishes platform-generated answer text from any office-reviewed transcript, summary, FAQ, or notice even when both appear beside the same recording.
ai_video_answer_surface_label: Example AI-over-video posture for official voter-information media routes
current_help_recovery_note: When the AI answer is incomplete, stale, or too broad for the voter's case, the route points back to the current official page, reviewed FAQ/help entry, or named office contact instead of treating the generated answer as controlling.
delivery_role_note: The service reviews player-native AI summaries and question-answer modules so generated answers over already-open official media remain subordinate to the full recording, any reviewed transcript or written FAQ/help lane, and the current office-controlled route rather than quietly becoming a shadow official briefing.
grounding_limitations_note: Transcript grounding, transcript-language mismatch, and any additional platform/web grounding are treated as explicit answer limitations rather than invisible implementation detail.
multilingual_boundary_note: If the AI module can answer in other languages, those answers remain subordinate to the source recording plus any reviewed official translated/help route.

reviewed_ai_answer_contexts.context_note: Reviewed whether the official recording page or embed exposes an ask-this-video, summarize-this-video, or similar AI answer surface.
Reviewed whether answer quality or availability depends on transcript presence, transcript length, transcript language, or autogenerated transcript correctness.
Reviewed whether suggested questions, short answer chips, or answer-language selection can overstate certainty or outrun the office's reviewed translated/help lane.
Reviewed whether the AI surface can point to moments in the recording or expose portable answer fragments that may travel farther than the player.
